description: The femur is the powerful thigh bone whose sweeping planes define the leg's bulk and channel weight from the pelvis to the knee.

landmarks.name: Head of the femur
landmarks.desc: Rounded articular sphere that nests into the acetabulum and anchors the thigh's sweeping arc.

landmarks.name: Neck of the femur
landmarks.desc: Constricted bridge angling the head toward the shaft and setting the tilt of the thigh.

landmarks.name: Greater trochanter
landmarks.desc: Lateral bony knob palpable at the hip, marking the leverage of abductors and external rotators.

landmarks.name: Lesser trochanter
landmarks.desc: Medial posterior prominence where the iliopsoas tendon tucks under the pelvis.

landmarks.name: Intertrochanteric crest
landmarks.desc: Posterior ridge linking the trochanters and catching light as it turns into the shaft.

landmarks.name: Gluteal tuberosity
landmarks.desc: Rough lateral strip descending from the greater trochanter where the gluteus maximus grips.

landmarks.name: Linea aspera
landmarks.desc: Long posterior ridge that receives the thigh adductors and sculpts the posterior column.

landmarks.name: Medial condyle
landmarks.desc: Medial roller of the distal femur that broadens the knee and supports the semimembranosus insertion.

landmarks.name: Lateral condyle
landmarks.desc: Lateral articular mass that meets the tibia and gives the knee its rounded contour.

landmarks.name: Medial epicondyle
landmarks.desc: Projecting knob above the medial condyle that anchors the medial collateral ligament.

landmarks.name: Lateral epicondyle
landmarks.desc: Broad lateral flare providing attachment for the fibular collateral ligament.

landmarks.name: Adductor tubercle
landmarks.desc: Medial summit just above the condyle where the adductor magnus tendon ends.

landmarks.name: Patellar surface
landmarks.desc: Anterior groove guiding the patella and catching highlights across the knee.
